name: The Distraction
text: I think you may be becoming a slight distraction.

name: A Serious Problem
text: Actually... a rather serious one.

name: The Heart
text: I'd like to give you all the love I have.

name: And Some Back
text: And I'd probably be very happy receiving some of yours too.

name: Quite A Lot
text: Quite a lot, actually. 🤍

name: Your Bad Days
text: When you're having a difficult day, I want to be someone you can come home to.

name: Even In Silence
text: Even if all we do is sit quietly together.

name: I Will Annoy You
text: I fully intend to annoy you.

name: There Will Be Consequences
text: And I have accepted that there will be consequences.

name: Severe Consequences
text: Apparently, severe consequences.

name: Noted
text: Noted. 😭

name: Taking Care Of You
text: I want to take care of you in the little ways.

name: After A Long Day
text: Especially after a long day.

name: Your Safe Place
text: I want to be your safe place. 🤍

name: The Little Things
text: I want the little things too.

name: Falling Asleep
text: Falling asleep next to each other.

name: Random Adventures
text: Going on random little adventures just because we can.

name: Our Competitive Side
text: Getting unnecessarily competitive over things that absolutely do not matter.

name: The Sunset
text: Watching sunsets with you.

name: Quiet Evenings
text: Having quiet evenings where we don't really need to do anything.

name: The Pictures
text: Taking far too many pictures that we'll probably laugh at years from now.

name: Growing Together
text: I want to watch you become everything you're trying to become.

name: And You Watch Me
text: And I want you to watch me become everything I'm trying to become too.

name: Tomorrow
text: I don't know exactly what every tomorrow will look like.

name: Quite A Few Of Them
text: But I know I'd like to experience quite a few of them with you.

name: One Last Question
text: So... I suppose there's only one thing left for me to ask.

name: The Question
text: Ntokozo... will you be my girlfriend?
